status_definitions.SUPPORTED_EVALUABLE: A joined executed decision and transition exists in the target regime and exact run stratum; the arm has positive logged propensity, initial and one-step coverage, transition-sufficient state, observed preregistered reward, and independent whole-run validation support.
status_definitions.NOT_IDENTIFIED: The target arm has structural zero executed propensity in the regime or the treatment contrast remains unidentifiable. Conservative value penalties may not replace the missing intervention support.
status_definitions.OUT_OF_SUPPORT: The target regime, initial state, or exact run/code/hardware/scorer stratum lies outside all logged support.
status_definitions.SCHEMA_INCOMPLETE: The arm is behavior-reachable in the current predictive policy, but actual evidence lacks a joined executed decision, transition-sufficient Z-A-R-Z-prime row, typed estimand/time law, or whole-run fold custody.

transition_schema_audit.audit: RunTreatmentManifest can carry treatment, base checkpoint, seed, machine/backend/axis, data order, stage plan, and scorer/cache custody.

StateSummary commits to boundary history and optional checkpoint custody, but Markov sufficiency is explicitly unproved; producer RNG/controller hashes remain null and not every verdict boundary carries a complete checkpoint.
ActionSummary carries the transition arm while ExplorationDecisionRow carries alternatives and propensities, but TransitionRow has no validated decision_id/regime join.

RewardObservation names an estimand, but the trainer currently emits negative_implied_score rather than the preregistered one-boundary full-score gain and the schema has no target time-law or censoring identity.
CoverageReceiptRow is target-policy-wide; no typed regime/stratum key or checker enforcement proves per-regime overlap.
No row freezes outer whole-run folds, inner chronological folds, split seed, estimator version, or pre-outcome target-policy hash.
The trainer producer emits aggregate pair sentinels and lacks typed loss-term closure, negative controls, and the frozen/no-update positive control required by hcm_l4_residual_check.

check_fore_support is a necessary structural gate only; its one-run positive test does not require multi-trajectory overlap, regime-specific support, a decision-transition join, or a replay proof of Markov sufficiency.

run_stratum.out_of_support_rule: Any target whose exact key has no logged initial-state and one-step coverage receipt is OUT_OF_SUPPORT, never pooled by assumed equivalence.
